entities.summary: Thomas George Doran was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church who served as the eighth bishop of the Diocese of Rockford in Illinois from 1994 to 2012. Doran also served on the Supreme Tribunal of the Apostolic Signatura in Rome, the highest court of the Catholic Church.
